description: HIGHLY SIGNIFICANT — AN UNPOSED PATROL PHOTOGRAPH IN DENSE JUNGLE. Under a low canopy of vines and saplings, a young American soldier in DUCK-HUNTER CAMOUFLAGE shirt and utility cap crouches low, looking back over his shoulder directly into the lens, mouth open as if speaking. Close behind him crouches a Vietnamese soldier in a dark/black shirt; further back, partially obscured by foliage, stands another Vietnamese soldier in duck-hunter camouflage and floppy hat. At right foreground, the out-of-focus torso and clasped hands of a fourth man (camouflage, ring on finger, dark object slung) frames the shot. The photographer is IN the file with them — this is movement through brush, not a posed scene.
